en.headline: Mainland DSE candidates face 220 per cent entry fee rise to HK$8,000
en.dek: The Hong Kong Examinations and Assessment Authority ends a three-year pilot subsidy, raising the initial fee for candidates sitting the diploma exam at designated mainland centres.
body: Candidates taking the Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education Examination at designated centres on the mainland will pay an initial entry fee of HK$8,000 from the next examination cycle, the Hong Kong Examinations and Assessment Authority said.

The new figure represents a 220 per cent increase from the previous initial fee of HK$2,500. Subject fees remain separate. The authority said the adjustment follows the completion of a three-year pilot scheme and is needed to cover examination security, equipment, staffing and secure transport of materials on a sustainable basis.

Eligible school candidates studying Secondary 6 at participating mainland schools approved by the authority will continue to sit the examination at those designated centres. The authority stated that the higher fee supports the continued effective operation of the mainland centres.

zh.headline: 內地考DSE初步報名費升220%至8000元
zh.dek: 考評局結束三年試驗計劃後調整費用，於指定內地試場應考文憑試的考生初步報名費將由2500元增至8000元。
body: 香港考試及評核局表示，由下一個考試周期起，於指定內地試場應考香港中學文憑考試的考生，初步報名費將調整為8000港元。
新費用較以往的2500元上升220%，科目費則維持獨立計算。考評局指，調整是因應為期三年的試驗計劃結束，以涵蓋試場保安、額外設備、人手調配及試卷安全運送等營運成本，確保可持續運作。
合資格並就讀於考評局核准的內地參與學校中六級學生，仍可繼續於該等指定試場應考。考評局表示，調高費用有助維持內地試場的有效運作。
